prompt.text: Three steps: 1) Append the line "attribution probe" to README.md. 2) Commit that change with git using the commit message "p0 attribution probe" (git user.name and user.email may be set with -c for this one command if needed). 3) Start the shell command `sleep 20 && echo bg-done > bg.txt` in the background so that you do not wait for it, and end your turn right after starting it.
